<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Seasong](/Feats.aspx?ID=5346) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 36

</column>

---

Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices. You become trained in [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45). If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the [Virtuosic Performer](/Feats.aspx?ID=5235) skill feat for singing, and your voice carries equally well above and below water.
name: Seasong
